meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Create New Version" opens the "Are you sure you want to create a new version?" window

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid on the buyer's Responses tab.
Open the version-creation confirmation without selecting an action in the window.

args.text: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Verify the expected confirmation question is displayed.
Verify the confirmation window offers Cancel.
Verify the confirmation window offers Create a New Version.
